releases.summary: Promo Menupage Automation 0.5.50 Word-first workflow with PDF schedule import
notes: Google Doc sync is not part of this release; the established Word drop workflow remains primary
The same intake accepts DOCX or PDF without adding a new team workflow
PDF is parsed directly without OCR or Word conversion
Real Word-to-PDF validation matched 163/163 schedule rows for Day, Page, Code, Time, Program, Poster, type and duration
Malformed or unreadable PDF fails closed and preserves the saved schedule
PyMuPDF 1.26.4 is bundled for offline Team Setup and Update
Word remains recommended when red font formatting itself is operationally important because PDF export can flatten font color metadata
